learning_outcomes.text: Students know the most important material-specific properties of light metals Al, Mg, Ti.
They are able to explain the practical relevance of light metal characteristic values.
Students master the correct alloy selection for product development.
Students understand how to adapt manufacturing processes to light metals.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the materials science of light metals
Importance of material characteristic values for application technology in lightweight construction
Aluminum alloys: properties, special features and application
Sources of error in semi-finished product manufacturing and further processing
Aluminum material technology: forming and joining
Magnesium alloys and their processing and application
Properties of titanium and its alloys with application examples and application technology
assessment_rules: The allocation of credit points requires a passed module examination. The grade is weighted according to credit points. The specific assessment method (exam or assignment/presentation) is determined at the beginning of the lecture.
